criteria.requirement: Repair isdistinct for reiterable data sources that implement __iter__ but no length protocol. Scan once, stop at the first duplicate and preserve hashability/error semantics. Keep the existing sized-sequence fast path, propagate errors from a genuinely implemented __len__ or iterator, and do not read a second iterator or consume unreachable tails. Preserve iterators, lists, empty input and exported namespaces.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
